library_name: Destiny Core Prestige Talents — General I
notes: Detailed paraphrases of Core Rulebook prestige talents. Prestige access is recorded as metadata because the current sheet combines prestige levels.

rules.name: Elusive Dogfighter
rules.description: Outmaneuver an opposing pilot so their dogfight attack is far less accurate.

mechanics.trigger: You win the opposed Pilot check used to attack in a dogfight.
mechanics.effect: That pilot takes -10 on the resulting attack roll.

rules.name: Full Throttle
rules.description: Push a vehicle to extreme speed with exceptional consistency.

mechanics.effect: You may take 10 on Pilot checks made to increase vehicle speed. When piloting with all-out movement, the vehicle moves up to five times its speed instead of four times.

rules.name: Juke
rules.description: Fight defensively from the cockpit while retaining offensive pressure.

mechanics.trigger: You fight defensively while serving as vehicle pilot.
mechanics.effect: The vehicle gains +5 dodge to Reflex Defense even if you make an attack.

rules.name: Keep It Together
rules.description: Prevent a threshold-breaking hit from worsening your vehicle's condition.

mechanics.trigger: A vehicle you pilot takes damage equal to or greater than its damage threshold.
mechanics.effect: The vehicle does not move down the condition track from exceeding its threshold; damage is otherwise resolved normally.

rules.name: Pursuit
rules.description: Excel at forcing another vehicle into a dogfight.

mechanics.trigger: Make a Pilot check to initiate a dogfight.
mechanics.effect: Roll twice and keep the better result.

rules.name: Vehicular Evasion
rules.description: Use evasive piloting to reduce or avoid area-attack damage.

mechanics.trigger: A functioning vehicle you pilot is targeted by an area attack.
mechanics.effect: On a hit, the vehicle takes half damage; on a miss, it takes no damage.
mechanics.special: Cannot be used while the vehicle is stationary or disabled.

rules.name: Dogfight Gunner
rules.description: Fire vehicle weapons accurately while another pilot handles the dogfight.

mechanics.trigger: Your vehicle is in a dogfight and you are not its pilot.
mechanics.effect: You take no dogfight penalty on attacks with vehicle weapons.

rules.name: Expert Gunner
rules.description: Improve accuracy with mounted vehicle weapons.

mechanics.effect: Gain +1 on attack rolls made with vehicle weapons.

rules.name: Quick Trigger
rules.description: Fire at a vehicle as it leaves close weapon range.

mechanics.trigger: An enemy vehicle leaves your square or an adjacent square.
mechanics.effect: Make one attack against that vehicle.

rules.name: System Hit
rules.description: Damage vehicle systems more severely when a hit exceeds threshold.

mechanics.trigger: Your attack damages a vehicle for at least its damage threshold.
mechanics.effect: Move the vehicle one additional step down the condition track beyond the normal threshold effect.

rules.name: Hunter's Mark
rules.description: An aimed ranged hit also degrades the quarry's condition.

mechanics.trigger: You aim and then hit with a ranged attack.
mechanics.effect: Move the target -1 condition step in addition to dealing damage.

rules.name: Hunter's Target
rules.description: Designate one opponent as your quarry and deal increased damage to it.

mechanics.effect: Each successful melee or ranged attack against it gains bonus damage equal to your Bounty Hunter class level.

rules.name: Notorious (Bounty Hunter)
rules.description: Your reputation makes undisguised intimidation more reliable.

mechanics.trigger: Make Persuasion to intimidate while not disguised.
mechanics.effect: Roll twice and keep the better result.

rules.name: Nowhere to Hide
rules.description: Retry attempts to gather information about a specific person's whereabouts.

mechanics.trigger: Make Gather Information to locate a specific individual.
mechanics.effect: You may reroll, but must keep the second result.

rules.name: Relentless
rules.description: Your designated quarry cannot force you down the condition track.

mechanics.target: The opponent designated by Hunter's Target.
mechanics.effect: Attacks and effects originating from that target do not move you down the condition track; damage and other effects still apply.

rules.name: Ruthless Negotiator
rules.description: Negotiate bounty payments with intimidating confidence.

mechanics.trigger: Make Persuasion to haggle over a bounty's price.
mechanics.effect: Roll twice and keep the better result.

rules.name: Debilitating Shot
rules.description: An aimed ranged hit pushes the victim down the condition track.

mechanics.trigger: You aim and then hit with a ranged attack.
mechanics.effect: Move the target -1 condition step in addition to dealing damage.

rules.name: Deceptive Shot
rules.description: Feint at range to compromise a nearby target's defenses.

mechanics.use: Two swift actions in the same turn.
mechanics.target: One target in line of sight within 6 squares.
mechanics.effect: On success, the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense against your attacks.
mechanics.duration: Until start of your next turn.

rules.name: Improved Quick Draw
rules.description: Draw and fire a pistol in a surprise round even when caught unaware.

mechanics.trigger: A surprise round begins while you carry a pistol in hand or holster.
mechanics.effect: You may draw it and make one attack during the surprise round even if surprised. If surprised, this is the single action you take.

rules.name: Knockdown Shot
rules.description: An aimed ranged hit knocks an appropriately sized target prone.

mechanics.trigger: You aim and then hit with a ranged attack.
mechanics.effect: Knock the target prone in addition to dealing damage.
mechanics.special: Cannot knock down a target two or more size categories larger than you.

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Pistols)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple pistol attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple pistol attacks as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

rules.name: Ranged Disarm
rules.description: Attempt to disarm with a ranged weapon without risking retaliation.

mechanics.effect: You may make disarm attempts using ranged attacks. A failed ranged disarm does not grant the opponent the normal free attack against you.

rules.name: Trigger Work
rules.description: Use Rapid Shot without its normal attack penalty.

mechanics.effect: Take no attack-roll penalty from Rapid Shot; all other requirements and effects remain.
